_geometry_assumptions._source: 1 deg latitude ~ 111000 m; 1 deg longitude ~ 111000 * cos(34.72 deg) m

objects._note: RQ-86 orbit center; this is the building the MQ-800 is supposed to be designating. Cross-source validators expect target_position_x/y near here.
